<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="asciidoc-tooltip-wrapper"><code>lax</code><span class="asciidoc-tooltip">Authentication succeeds if at least one of the registered HTTP authentication mechanisms creates the identity.</span></span>, <span class="asciidoc-tooltip-wrapper"><code>strict</code><span class="asciidoc-tooltip">Authentication succeeds if all the registered HTTP authentication mechanisms create the identity. Typically, inclusive authentication should be in the strict mode when the credentials are carried over mTLS, when both mTLS and another authentication, for example, OIDC bearer token authentication, must succeed. In such cases, <code>SecurityIdentity</code> created by the first mechanism, mTLS, can be injected, identities created by other mechanisms will be available on <code>SecurityIdentity</code>.</span></span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><span class="asciidoc-tooltip-wrapper"><code>strict</code><span class="asciidoc-tooltip">Authentication succeeds if all the registered HTTP authentication mechanisms create the identity. Typically, inclusive authentication should be in the strict mode when the credentials are carried over mTLS, when both mTLS and another authentication, for example, OIDC bearer token authentication, must succeed. In such cases, <code>SecurityIdentity</code> created by the first mechanism, mTLS, can be injected, identities created by other mechanisms will be available on <code>SecurityIdentity</code>.</span></span></p></td>

<p>Tells browsers if front-end JavaScript can be allowed to access credentials when the request&#8217;s credentials mode, <code>Request.credentials</code>, is set to <code>include</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Default: <code>true</code> if the <code>quarkus.http.cors.origins</code> property is set and matches the precise <code>Origin</code> header value.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-757">QUARKUS_HTTP_CORS_ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-757" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-cors-return-exact-origins"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-cors-return-exact-origins"><code>quarkus.http.cors.return-exact-origins</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.cors.return-exact-origins' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-758" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to return the exact request origin in the <code>Access-Control-Allow-Origin</code> response header.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When set to <code>true</code> (the default), the filter echoes back the request&#8217;s <code>Origin</code> header value. When set to <code>false</code> and <code>origins</code> is configured as <code>*</code>, the response will contain the literal <code>Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *</code> instead of echoing the request origin. This is useful for public APIs where HTTP caching is important, as echoing the origin requires <code>Vary: Origin</code> and defeats shared caches.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Note: When <code>*</code> is returned as the origin, <code>Access-Control-Allow-Credentials</code> is forced to <code>false</code> per the CORS specification.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-758">QUARKUS_HTTP_CORS_RETURN_EXACT_ORIGINS</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-758" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden odd">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-cors-vary-origin"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-cors-vary-origin"><code>quarkus.http.cors.vary-origin</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.cors.vary-origin' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-759" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to add the <code>Vary: Origin</code> response header to CORS responses when the origin is not a wildcard.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <code>Vary: Origin</code> header tells HTTP caches that the response depends on the request&#8217;s <code>Origin</code> header, preventing a cached response for one origin from being served to a different origin.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This should remain enabled (the default) in most setups, especially when a reverse proxy or CDN may cache responses.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-759">QUARKUS_HTTP_CORS_VARY_ORIGIN</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-759" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>

<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set the SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE HTTP/2 setting.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Allows the sender to inform the remote endpoint of the maximum size of the header compression table used to decode header blocks, in octets. The encoder can select any size equal to or less than this value by using signaling specific to the header compression format inside a header block. The initial value is <code>4,096</code> octets.</p>

<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.limits.rst-flood-max-rst-frame-per-window' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-785" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set the max number of RST frame allowed per time window, this is used to prevent <a href="https://github.com/netty/netty/security/advisories/GHSA-xpw8-rcwv-8f8p">HTTP/2 RST frame flood DDOS attacks</a>. The default value is <code>200</code>, setting zero or a negative value, disables flood protection.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-785">QUARKUS_HTTP_LIMITS_RST_FLOOD_MAX_RST_FRAME_PER_WINDOW</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-785" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-786" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">

<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.access-log.pattern' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-789" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The access log pattern.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If this is the string <code>common</code>, <code>combined</code> or <code>long</code> then this will use one of the specified named formats:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p>common: <code>%h %l %u %t "%r" %s %b</code> - combined: <code>%h %l %u %t "%r" %s %b "%{i,Referer}" "%{i,User-Agent}"</code> - long: <code>%r\n%{ALL_REQUEST_HEADERS}</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Otherwise, consult the Quarkus documentation for the full list of variables that can be used. Note that enabling the <code>%{ALL_REQUEST_HEADERS}</code> attribute directly or with a <code>long</code> named format introduces a risk of sensitive header values being logged.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>HTTP <code>Authorization</code> header value is always masked. Use the <code>masked-headers()</code> property to mask other sensitive headers.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-789">QUARKUS_HTTP_ACCESS_LOG_PATTERN</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-789" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-803" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set the delay between two computations of performances for channels. If set to 0, no stats are computed. Despite 0 is accepted (no accounting), it is recommended to set a positive value for the check interval, even if it is high since the precision of the traffic shaping depends on the period where the traffic is computed. In this case, a suggested value is something close to 5 or 10 minutes.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If not default, it defaults to 1s.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-803">QUARKUS_HTTP_TRAFFIC_SHAPING_CHECK_INTERVAL</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-803" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock"><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_section_quarkus-http-proxy"></a> <span class="section-name section-level0"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_section_quarkus-http-proxy">Proxy</a></span></p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Type</p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Default</p></th>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-use-proxy-protocol"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-use-proxy-protocol"><code>quarkus.http.proxy.use-proxy-protocol</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.proxy.use-proxy-protocol' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-812" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set whether the server should use the HA <code>PROXY</code> protocol when serving requests from behind a proxy. (see the <a href="https://www.haproxy.org/download/1.8/doc/proxy-protocol.txt">PROXY Protocol</a>). When set to <code>true</code>, the remote address returned will be the one from the actual connecting client. If it is set to <code>false</code> (default), the remote address returned will be the one from the proxy.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-812">QUARKUS_HTTP_PROXY_USE_PROXY_PROTOCOL</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-812" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>

<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>false</code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden odd">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-allow-forwarded"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-allow-forwarded"><code>quarkus.http.proxy.allow-forwarded</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.proxy.allow-forwarded' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-814" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If this is true and proxy address forwarding is enabled then the standard <code>Forwarded</code> header will be used. In case the not standard <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> header is enabled and detected on HTTP requests, the standard header has the precedence. Activating this together with <code>quarkus.http.proxy.allow-x-forwarded</code> has security implications as clients can forge requests with a forwarded header that is not overwritten by the proxy. Therefore, proxies should strip unexpected <code>Forwarded</code> or <code>X-Forwarded-*</code> headers from the client.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-814">QUARKUS_HTTP_PROXY_ALLOW_FORWARDED</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-814" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-822" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Adds the header <code>X-Forwarded-Trusted-Proxy</code> if the request is forwarded by a trusted proxy. The value is <code>true</code> if the request is forwarded by a trusted proxy, otherwise <code>null</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The forwarded parser detects forgery attempts and if the incoming request contains this header, it will be removed from the request.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <code>X-Forwarded-Trusted-Proxy</code> header is a custom header, not part of the standard <code>Forwarded</code> header.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-trusted-proxies"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-http-proxy-trusted-proxies"><code>quarkus.http.proxy.trusted-proxies</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.http.proxy.trusted-proxies' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-823" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Configure the list of trusted proxy addresses. Received <code>Forwarded</code>, <code>X-Forwarded</code> or <code>X-Forwarded-*</code> headers from any other proxy address will be ignored. The trusted proxy address should be specified as the IP address (IPv4 or IPv6), hostname or Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) notation. Please note that Quarkus needs to perform DNS lookup for all hostnames during the request. For that reason, using hostnames is not recommended.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Examples of a socket address in the form of <code>host</code> or <code>host:port</code>:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>127.0.0.1:8084</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:8084</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[::]</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>localhost</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>localhost:8084</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Examples of a CIDR notation:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>::/128</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>::/0</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>127.0.0.0/8</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Please bear in mind that IPv4 CIDR won&#8217;t match request sent from the IPv6 address and the other way around.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-823">QUARKUS_HTTP_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-823" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>All proxy addresses are trusted</code></p></td>

<p>The trusted proxy&#8217;s Subject Distinguished Name (DN) in RFC 2253 format. The proxy is trusted when its TLS client certificate&#8217;s Subject DN contains all the components specified in this value. <div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The HTTP host</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>In dev/test mode this defaults to localhost, in prod mode this defaults to 0.0.0.0</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Defaulting to 0.0.0.0 makes it easier to deploy Quarkus to container, however it is not suitable for dev/test mode as other people on the network can connect to your development machine.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>As an exception, when running in Windows Subsystem for Linux (WSL), the HTTP host defaults to 0.0.0.0 even in dev/test mode since using localhost makes the application inaccessible.</p>

<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-use-semicolon-as-query-param-delimiter"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-use-semicolon-as-query-param-delimiter"><code>quarkus.management.use-semicolon-as-query-param-delimiter</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.management.use-semicolon-as-query-param-delimiter' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-868" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether the HTTP server should treat the semicolon (<code>;</code>) as a query parameter delimiter, in addition to the ampersand (<code>&amp;</code>).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When set to <code>true</code> (the default), a request like <code>/path?a=1;b=2</code> is parsed as two parameters (<code>a=1</code> and <code>b=2</code>). When set to <code>false</code>, the semicolon is treated as a literal character and the request yields a single parameter (<code>a=1;b=2</code>).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The default is <code>true</code> to preserve backward compatibility. It will change to <code>false</code> in Quarkus 4, as using the semicolon as a query parameter delimiter is uncommon and can cause issues when semicolons appear as part of parameter values.</p>
</div>

<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set the SETTINGS_HEADER_TABLE_SIZE HTTP/2 setting.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Allows the sender to inform the remote endpoint of the maximum size of the header compression table used to decode header blocks, in octets. The encoder can select any size equal to or less than this value by using signaling specific to the header compression format inside a header block. The initial value is <code>4,096</code> octets.</p>

<p>Set SETTINGS_MAX_CONCURRENT_STREAMS HTTP/2 setting.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Indicates the maximum number of concurrent streams that the sender will allow. This limit is directional: it applies to the number of streams that the sender permits the receiver to create. Initially, there is no limit to this value. It is recommended that this value be no smaller than 100, to not unnecessarily limit parallelism.</p>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>Set the SETTINGS_MAX_HEADER_LIST_SIZE HTTP/2 setting. This advisory setting informs a peer of the maximum size of header list that the sender is prepared to accept, in octets. The default value is <code>8192</code></p>

Otherwise, the files sent using <code>multipart/form-data</code> will not be stored locally, and <code>io.vertx.ext.web.RoutingContext.fileUploads()</code> will always return an empty collection. <p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-proxy-allow-forwarded"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-proxy-allow-forwarded"><code>quarkus.management.proxy.allow-forwarded</code></a></span>

</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-898" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If this is true and proxy address forwarding is enabled then the standard <code>Forwarded</code> header will be used. In case the not standard <code>X-Forwarded-For</code> header is enabled and detected on HTTP requests, the standard header has the precedence. Activating this together with <code>quarkus.http.proxy.allow-x-forwarded</code> has security implications as clients can forge requests with a forwarded header that is not overwritten by the proxy. Therefore, proxies should strip unexpected <code>Forwarded</code> or <code>X-Forwarded-*</code> headers from the client.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">

<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Adds the header <code>X-Forwarded-Trusted-Proxy</code> if the request is forwarded by a trusted proxy. The value is <code>true</code> if the request is forwarded by a trusted proxy, otherwise <code>null</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The forwarded parser detects forgery attempts and if the incoming request contains this header, it will be removed from the request.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <code>X-Forwarded-Trusted-Proxy</code> header is a custom header, not part of the standard <code>Forwarded</code> header.</p>
</div>

<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-proxy-trusted-proxies"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-proxy-trusted-proxies"><code>quarkus.management.proxy.trusted-proxies</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.management.proxy.trusted-proxies' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-907" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Configure the list of trusted proxy addresses. Received <code>Forwarded</code>, <code>X-Forwarded</code> or <code>X-Forwarded-*</code> headers from any other proxy address will be ignored. The trusted proxy address should be specified as the IP address (IPv4 or IPv6), hostname or Classless Inter-Domain Routing (CIDR) notation. Please note that Quarkus needs to perform DNS lookup for all hostnames during the request. For that reason, using hostnames is not recommended.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Examples of a socket address in the form of <code>host</code> or <code>host:port</code>:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>127.0.0.1:8084</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[0:0:0:0:0:0:0:1]:8084</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>[::]</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>localhost</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>localhost:8084</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Examples of a CIDR notation:</p>
</div>
<div class="ulist">
<ul>
<li>
<p><code>::/128</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>::/0</code></p>
</li>
<li>
<p><code>127.0.0.0/8</code></p>
</li>
</ul>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Please bear in mind that IPv4 CIDR won&#8217;t match request sent from the IPv6 address and the other way around.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-907">QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_PROXY_TRUSTED_PROXIES</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-907" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>All proxy addresses are trusted</code></p></td>

<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-913" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The methods that this permission set applies to. If this is not set then they apply to all methods.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Note that if a request matches any path from any permission set, but does not match the constraint due to the method not being listed then the request will be denied.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Method specific permissions take precedence over matches that do not have any methods set.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This means that for example if Quarkus is configured to allow GET and POST requests to /admin to and no other permissions are configured PUT requests to /admin will be denied.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">

<p>The <code>Access-Control-Max-Age</code> response header value in <code>java.time.Duration</code> format.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Informs the browser how long it can cache the results of a preflight request.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-937">QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_CORS_ACCESS_CONTROL_MAX_AGE</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-937" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-access-control-allow-credentials"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-access-control-allow-credentials"><code>quarkus.management.cors.access-control-allow-credentials</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.management.cors.access-control-allow-credentials' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-938" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <code>Access-Control-Allow-Credentials</code> response header.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Tells browsers if front-end JavaScript can be allowed to access credentials when the request&#8217;s credentials mode, <code>Request.credentials</code>, is set to <code>include</code>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Default: <code>true</code> if the <code>quarkus.http.cors.origins</code> property is set and matches the precise <code>Origin</code> header value.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-938">QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_CORS_ACCESS_CONTROL_ALLOW_CREDENTIALS</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-938" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-return-exact-origins"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-return-exact-origins"><code>quarkus.management.cors.return-exact-origins</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.management.cors.return-exact-origins' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-939" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to return the exact request origin in the <code>Access-Control-Allow-Origin</code> response header.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When set to <code>true</code> (the default), the filter echoes back the request&#8217;s <code>Origin</code> header value. When set to <code>false</code> and <code>origins</code> is configured as <code>*</code>, the response will contain the literal <code>Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *</code> instead of echoing the request origin. This is useful for public APIs where HTTP caching is important, as echoing the origin requires <code>Vary: Origin</code> and defeats shared caches.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Note: When <code>*</code> is returned as the origin, <code>Access-Control-Allow-Credentials</code> is forced to <code>false</code> per the CORS specification.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-939">QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_CORS_RETURN_EXACT_ORIGINS</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-939" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-vary-origin"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-vertx-http_quarkus-management-cors-vary-origin"><code>quarkus.management.cors.vary-origin</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.management.cors.vary-origin' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-940" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to add the <code>Vary: Origin</code> response header to CORS responses when the origin is not a wildcard.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The <code>Vary: Origin</code> header tells HTTP caches that the response depends on the request&#8217;s <code>Origin</code> header, preventing a cached response for one origin from being served to a different origin.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This should remain enabled (the default) in most setups, especially when a reverse proxy or CDN may cache responses.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-940">QUARKUS_MANAGEMENT_CORS_VARY_ORIGIN</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-940" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<p><span class="icon"><i class="fa fa-lock" title="Fixed at build time"></i></span> <a id="quarkus-elasticsearch-rest-client_quarkus-elasticsearch-devservices-shared"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-elasticsearch-rest-client_quarkus-elasticsearch-devservices-shared"><code>quarkus.elasticsearch.devservices.shared</code></a></span>

</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-961" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether the Elasticsearch server managed by Quarkus Dev Services is shared.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>When shared, Quarkus looks for running containers using label-based service discovery. If a matching container is found, it is used, and so a second one is not started. Otherwise, Dev Services for Elasticsearch starts a new container.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The discovery uses the <code>quarkus-dev-service-elasticsearch</code> label. The value is configured using the <code>service-name</code> property.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Container sharing is only used in dev mode.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-961">QUARKUS_ELASTICSEARCH_DEVSERVICES_SHARED</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-961" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.elasticsearch.devservices.service-name' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-962" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The value of the <code>quarkus-dev-service-elasticsearch</code> label attached to the started container.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This property is used when <code>shared</code> is set to <code>true</code>. In this case, before starting a container, Dev Services for Elasticsearch looks for a container with the <code>quarkus-dev-service-elasticsearch</code> label set to the configured value. If found, it will use this container instead of starting a new one. Otherwise it starts a new container with the <code>quarkus-dev-service-elasticsearch</code> label set to the specified value.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This property is used when you need multiple shared Elasticsearch servers.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-962">QUARKUS_ELASTICSEARCH_DEVSERVICES_SERVICE_NAME</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-962" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>elasticsearch</code></p></td>

<p><span class="icon"><i class="fa fa-lock" title="Fixed at build time"></i></span> <a id="quarkus-elasticsearch-rest-client_quarkus-elasticsearch-devservices-reuse"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-elasticsearch-rest-client_quarkus-elasticsearch-devservices-reuse"><code>quarkus.elasticsearch.devservices.reuse</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.elasticsearch.devservices.reuse' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-964" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether to keep Dev Service containers running <strong>after a dev mode session or test suite execution</strong>
to reuse them in the next dev mode session or test suite execution.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Within a dev mode session or test suite execution,
Quarkus will always reuse Dev Services as long as their configuration
(username, password, environment, port bindings, &#8230;&#8203;) did not change.
This feature is specifically about keeping containers running
<strong>when Quarkus is not running</strong> to reuse them across runs.</p>
</div>
<div class="admonitionblock warning">
<table>
<tr>
<td class="icon">
<i class="fa icon-warning" title="Warning"></i>
</td>
<td class="content">
This feature needs to be enabled explicitly in <code>testcontainers.properties</code>,
may require changes to how you configure data initialization in dev mode and tests,
and may leave containers running indefinitely, forcing you to stop and remove them manually.
See <a href="/guides/elasticsearch-dev-services/#reuse">this section of the documentation</a> for more information.
</td>
</tr>
</table>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>This configuration property is set to <code>true</code> by default,
so it is mostly useful to <strong>disable</strong> reuse,
if you enabled it in <code>testcontainers.properties</code>
but only want to use it for some of your Quarkus applications.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-964">QUARKUS_ELASTICSEARCH_DEVSERVICES_REUSE</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-964" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>

<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock"><span class="extension-name">Elytron Security Properties File</span></p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Type</p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Default</p></th>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-plain-text"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-plain-text"><code>quarkus.security.users.embedded.plain-text</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.security.users.embedded.plain-text' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1018" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If the passwords are stored in the property file as plain text, e.g. <code>quarkus.security.users.embedded.users.alice=AlicesSecretPassword</code>. If this is false (the default) then it is expected that passwords are hashed as per the <code>algorithm</code> config property.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1018">QUARKUS_SECURITY_USERS_EMBEDDED_PLAIN_TEXT</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1018" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>false</code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden odd">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-algorithm"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-algorithm"><code>quarkus.security.users.embedded.algorithm</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.security.users.embedded.algorithm' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1019" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The algorithm with which user password is hashed. The library expects a password prepended with the username and the realm, in the form ALG( username ":" realm ":" password ) in hexadecimal format.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>For example, on a Unix-like system we can produce the expected hash for Alice logging in to the Quarkus realm with password AlicesSecretPassword using <code>echo -n "alice:Quarkus:AlicesSecretPassword" | sha512sum</code>, and thus set <code>quarkus.security.users.embedded.users.alice=c8131&#8230;&#8203;4546</code> (full hash output abbreviated here). This property is ignored if <code>plainText</code> is true.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1019">QUARKUS_SECURITY_USERS_EMBEDDED_ALGORITHM</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1019" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><code>digest-md5</code>, <code>digest-sha</code>, <code>digest-sha-256</code>, <code>digest-sha-384</code>, <code>digest-sha-512</code>, <code>digest-sha-512-256</code></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>digest-sha-512</code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><a id="quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-users-users"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file_quarkus-security-users-embedded-users-users"><code>quarkus.security.users.embedded.users."users"</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.security.users.embedded.users."users"' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1020" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>The realm users user1=password\nuser2=password2&#8230;&#8203; mapping. See <a href="#embedded-users">Embedded Users</a>.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1020">QUARKUS_SECURITY_USERS_EMBEDDED_USERS__USERS_</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1020" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>

<li>
<p>This schema will be the default for the database connection (provided the database supports this concept).</p>
</li>
</ul>

<div class="paragraph">
<p>The name of the TLS configuration to use.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If not set and the default TLS configuration is configured (<code>quarkus.tls.*</code>) then that will be used. If a name is configured, it uses the configuration from <code>quarkus.tls.&lt;name&gt;.*</code> If a name is configured, but no TLS configuration is found with that name then an error will be thrown.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If no TLS configuration is set, and <code>quarkus.tls.*</code> is not configured, then, <code>quarkus.grpc.clients.$client-name.tls</code> will be used.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Important: This is only supported when using the Quarkus (Vert.x-based) gRPC client.</p>

<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><p class="tableblock"><span class="extension-name">Hibernate Envers</span></p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Type</p></th>
<th class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">Default</p></th>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon"><i class="fa fa-lock" title="Fixed at build time"></i></span> <a id="quarkus-hibernate-envers_quarkus-hibernate-envers-enabled"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-hibernate-envers_quarkus-hibernate-envers-enabled"><code>quarkus.hibernate-envers.enabled</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.hibernate-envers.enabled' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1170" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether Hibernate Envers is enabled &lt;strong&gt;during the build&lt;/strong&gt;.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If Hibernate Envers is disabled during the build, all processing related to Hibernate Envers will be skipped,
and the audit entities will not be added to the Hibernate ORM metamodel
nor to the database schema that Hibernate ORM generates,
but it will not be possible to use Hibernate Envers at runtime:
<code>quarkus.hibernate-envers.active</code> will default to <code>false</code> and setting it to <code>true</code> will lead to an error.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1170">QUARKUS_HIBERNATE_ENVERS_ENABLED</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1170" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>
</div></div></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock">boolean</p></td>
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-middle"><p class="tableblock"><code>true</code></p></td>
</tr>
<tr class="row-collapsible row-collapsed row-with-desc row-hidden odd">
<td class="tableblock halign-left valign-top"><div class="content"><div class="paragraph">
<p><span class="icon"><i class="fa fa-lock" title="Fixed at build time"></i></span> <a id="quarkus-hibernate-envers_quarkus-hibernate-envers-active"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-hibernate-envers_quarkus-hibernate-envers-active"><code>quarkus.hibernate-envers.active</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.hibernate-envers.active' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p><code>quarkus.hibernate-envers."persistence-unit-name".active</code>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.hibernate-envers."persistence-unit-name".active' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1171" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether Hibernate Envers should be active for this persistence unit at runtime.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>If Hibernate Envers is not active, the audit entities will <strong>still</strong> be added to the Hibernate ORM metamodel
and to the database schema that Hibernate ORM generates:
you would need to disable Hibernate Envers at build time (i.e. set <code>quarkus.hibernate-envers.enabled</code> to <code>false</code>)
in order to avoid that.
However, when Hibernate Envers is not active, it will not process entity change events
nor create new versions of entities.
and accessing the AuditReader through AuditReaderFactory will not be possible.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Note that if Hibernate Envers is disabled (i.e. <code>quarkus.hibernate-envers.enabled</code> is set to <code>false</code>),
it won&#8217;t be active for any persistence unit, and setting this property to <code>true</code> will fail.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1171">QUARKUS_HIBERNATE_ENVERS_ACTIVE</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1171" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
<div class="paragraph description-decoration">
<p><i class="fa fa-chevron-down"></i><span>Show more</span></p>

<p><span class="icon"><i class="fa fa-lock" title="Fixed at build time"></i></span> <a id="quarkus-hibernate-orm_quarkus-hibernate-orm-log-session-metrics"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-hibernate-orm_quarkus-hibernate-orm-log-session-metrics"><code>quarkus.hibernate-orm.log-session-metrics</code></a></span>

<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1197" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Whether session metrics should be appended into the server log for each Hibernate session. This only has effect if statistics are enabled (<code>quarkus.hibernate-orm.statistics</code>). The default is false (which means both <code>statistics</code> and <code>log-session-metrics</code> need to be enabled for the session metrics to appear in the log).</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1197">QUARKUS_HIBERNATE_ORM_LOG_SESSION_METRICS</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1197" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>

<p><a id="quarkus-hibernate-orm_quarkus-hibernate-orm-request-scoped-enabled"></a> <span class="property-path"><a href="#quarkus-hibernate-orm_quarkus-hibernate-orm-request-scoped-enabled"><code>quarkus.hibernate-orm.request-scoped.enabled</code></a></span>
<button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-text='quarkus.hibernate-orm.request-scoped.enabled' title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
<div id="conf-collapsible-desc-1200" class="openblock description description-collapsed">
<div class="content">
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Enable or disable access to a Hibernate ORM <code>EntityManager</code>/<code>Session</code>/<code>StatelessSession</code> *when no transaction is active* but a request scope is. When enabled, the corresponding sessions will be read-only. Defaults to enabled for backwards compatibility, but disabling this is recommended, to avoid inconsistent resulsts caused by queries running outside of transactions.</p>
</div>
<div class="paragraph">
<p>Environment variable: <code id="env-var-1200">QUARKUS_HIBERNATE_ORM_REQUEST_SCOPED_ENABLED</code><button class="btn-copy fa fa-clipboard inline-btn-copy" data-clipboard-action="copy" data-clipboard-target="#env-var-1200" title="Copy to clipboard" do-not-collapse="true"></button></p>
</div>
</div>
</div>
